correctness.rationale: Rotate the deleted rim edge to (n−1,n) and split the vertices into the two length-n rails: the surviving wrap edge is t0–b(n−1), and the antipodal edges are the rungs. In the open ladder, deleting t1 with witness b0 and then b1 with witness t0 isolates a rung and leaves L(n−2), hence its independence complex is a sphere of degree ceil(n/2)−1. In the relative chains, exactly the faces containing both extra-edge endpoints survive. Ordering these endpoints first gives the augmented link chain complex shifted by two. The link rails are t2,…,t(n−2) and b1,…,b(n−3). Their n=4,5 bases are two isolated vertices and P4 (both complexes contractible); for n=6,7 the indicated folds leave two isolated edges. For n≥8 the four deletions t2,b3,t5,b4 have witnesses b1,b1,t3,t3 and leave the two isolated edges b1–b2,t3–t4 and the link on columns shifted by four. The important n=4k+3 relative map is a unit over Z: the even-rung join cycles both pair to ±1 with the indicator of an alternating maximal face in the appropriate degree. In the link the two terminal vertices b1,t(n−2) are dominated by b2,t(n−3), respectively; each interior odd column is dominated in both rows by its consecutive even-column choices. The quotient selects exactly the terms containing both endpoints. Thus the two rank-one groups cancel integrally. The n=4k+2 short exact sequence splits because its quotient is Z, yielding rank two, and the relative groups vanish in the other two classes. This establishes the unrestricted integral claim; the supplied mod-two output is only corroboration. In the generator argument ‘top-dimensional’ is read as the degree of the cycle, not the maximum face dimension of the ladder.

value.rationale: A rim fault is a natural operation on this highly symmetric family but changes its ordinary independence homology in two residue classes, including eliminating all reduced integral homology in an infinite class whose intact counterpart has a sphere. The result resolves an integral cancellation that Betti numbers alone cannot settle and yields a complete classification for this fault, not an isolated recomputation or a claim of contractibility.
